scope: Visible named-medicine acknowledgement on the main prescription page and outside collapsed voice editors
browserChecks: A named drug has a prominent review box directly in the main prescription list, with editable name and unit
Signing without acknowledgement scrolls and focuses the exact visible checkbox without submitting release
Missing unit directs focus to the visible unit field and acknowledgement becomes available after it is filled
Voice and main acknowledgement controls share state; the voice checkbox remains visible when editing fields are collapsed
Saving the visible acknowledgement persists it on the same draft and reload keeps it checked
Changing a unit clears old acknowledgement; checking again and signing auto-saves the current review before real release
The reviewed prescription completes the consultation through real APIs without uncaught UI errors

graph.scope: All carried R6/R7 changes; new untracked component reviewed separately
